- Risperidone dose remains unknown—critical to obtain (common starting doses: 1–2 mg/day; akathisia risk rises >3 mg/day).

This case presents a textbook, high-fidelity example of drug-induced akathisia with exceptional diagnostic rigor. The diagnosis is strengthened not only by the presence of the core triad (subjective urge to move, objective motor restlessness, rest-exacerbation), but—critically—by systematic and well-reasoned *exclusion* of key mimics across multiple domains: psychiatric (anxiety, RLS), toxic-metabolic (anticholinergic toxicity, serotonin syndrome), endocrine (hyperthyroidism), and neurological (dystonia, parkinsonism, tardive dyskinesia).
